author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a diagonal wrench with a ring end at the top right, a straight shaft and an open U jaw facing down-left; reads as a combination wrench like the reference. The rejected drawing was a squat, heavy shape. A first version with longer prongs looked like a tuning fork; the shaft was lengthened and the prongs shortened.
omissions: The outlined shaft becomes a single stroke and the ring head's small inner hole is dropped: an outlined 45-degree shaft only meets a circle at integer points with a 26-wide ring, and a hole inside the ring needs a ring of radius 9+.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: ring r5 at (37,11) split at (33,14); shaft 45 degrees to the jaw back (17,30); U jaw half circle of radius 4*sqrt2 about (13,34) with tips (17,38)/(9,30) and prongs to (13,42)/(6,33).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'wrench': diagonal spanner with an open jaw.
